resources.string: Open Google TV recommendations directly in Nuvio. Free, local and without an account.
Detects clicks on Google TV recommendation cards and opens the matching title in Nuvio.
Automatically moves focus to the next Google TV row when a sponsored card is selected.
Writes the focused Google TV row and the ad verdict to logcat. Read it with: adb logcat -s NuvioBridgeAds:D
Ready. TMDB is configured and Nuvio was detected.
A TMDB API v3 key is required. Enter it below and save it.
Nuvio was not detected. Install the current Nuvio TV build first.
The service listens only to clicks in the Google TV launcher. Titles are sent to TMDB for identification; no account, subscription or payment information is collected.
